senses.gloss: f. (used as adverb; a comp. of אך a. סרח less or more, v. נכי) in a lump, on measuring by sight.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 2:5">Dem. II, 5</cite> (Ms. M. <cite ref="A02458"><he>אסכרא</he></cite>); Y. ib. III, 23ᶜ <he>מוכרן א׳</he> he sells them in a lump (as many as there may be).
<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 4:2">Maas. Sh. IV, 2</cite>. Sifra B’ḥukk. Par. 4, ch. X; a. e.
